tag.en: 💅🦶 Spa combo: she knows every step
tag.vi: 💅🦶 Combo spa: khách biết rõ từng bước

occasion: You booked the gel mani + spa pedi combo and you know exactly what a spa pedicure should include.
constraints: You expect every step: the soak, the scrub, the mask, hot towels and a real foot and calf massage. You ask what the spa pedicure includes and you complain politely if a step seems skipped. You also check that the combo price is less than the two separately. A deep red on hands and toes.
openingLine: I'd like the gel mani and spa pedi combo. And I mean the full spa pedicure: scrub, mask, massage, everything.
